original.reason: It incorrectly replaces f(m!) by f(m), derives f(1)=1 from an unproved boundedness claim, asserts a divisibility forces equality without a bound, and falsely links f(n!) to f(n)!.

judgment.reason: Its central claim is only asserted through vague, unspecified subtractions and size comparisons; no valid rigidity proof is supplied.

It correctly identifies serious flaws in the original proof, but supplies neither a counterexample nor a correct proof of the stated theorem; its assertion that the theorem cannot be preserved is unsupported.

The decisive factorial-rigidity assertion is invoked without proof; the described substitutions do not establish the required remainder bounds.
